title: Aggressive LR schedule for 5-min window
reflection: Hypothesis was that aggressive learning rates and shorter warmdown would improve convergence in the fixed 5-minute budget. Result: val_bpb 1.003033 vs baseline 0.996598 (0.64% regression). The higher learning rates appear to have caused the model to overshoot optimal parameters or become unstable. The baseline schedule is better calibrated. For next round: try model capacity increases (depth) instead, as three other agents proposed, or try more conservative LR increases.
